company.name: Physical Intelligence (π)
company.source_note:
Physical Intelligence builds general-purpose robot foundation models via Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architecture. Core model π0 (open-sourced Feb 2024) processes visual inputs + natural language commands and executes physical actions. π0.7 released April 2026 as a steerable model with emergent capabilities. Revenue model includes foundation-model 'brains' capturing double-digit take-rate of robot ASPs via APIs, licensing, and vertical bundles. Targets industrial/commercial general-purpose robotics.
Total ~$1.1B funded; $70M Seed (~$400M val) + $400M Series A (~$2B val) + $600M Series B (~$5.6B val); investors include CapitalG, Sequoia, Khosla, Bond, Redpoint, Jeff Bezos, OpenAI, Thrive Capital, Lux Capital
Founded 2024 by ex-DeepMind & Berkeley researchers; emerged from stealth March 2024; ongoing research output (π0 → π0.5 → π0.6 → π0.7 milestone chain)
